top_signals.title: AMD Falls on China Risk; Ross Tumbles on Q4 Guidance | Stock Movers
top_signals.summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) shares are falling after Hunterbrook Capital said it shorted the stock, following a report by its media affiliate that the chipmaker is reliant on a potentially risky business in China.
- Ross Stores (ROST) shares are tumbling after the company gave weaker-than-expected guidance for the fourth quarter due to higher costs.
- Intuit (INTU) is the biggest decliner in the premarket after the software maker cut its full-year revenue forecast, driven by weak performance in Credit Karma, a personal finance platform that’s under increasing threat from agentic AI tools. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Schwab's Aguilar on ETF Growth, Privates and Prediction Markets
top_signals.summary: Schwab Asset Management CEO & CIO Omar Aguilar joins Bloomberg's Katie Greifeld and Eric Balchunas for a special edition of ETF IQ live on stage at the Bloomberg ETFs in Depth Conference in New York on November 26, 2026. Aguilar discusses Schwab’s growth in ETFs, how investors are using low-cost products to diversify portfolios, the firm’s approach to prediction markets and expanding retail access to private companies. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Venezuela’s Machado Urges More Drastic Overhaul of Oil Sector
top_signals.summary: Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado wants to reshape the country’s energy industry even beyond the dizzying changes it has undergone this year, signaling a more critical role for private industry should she clinch the presidency. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: J.P. Morgan’s Gatch on Where Active ETFs Go Next
top_signals.summary: J.P. Morgan Asset Management CEO George Gatch joins Bloomberg's Katie Greifeld and Eric Balchunas for a special edition of ETF IQ live on stage at the Bloomberg ETFs in Depth Conference in New York on November 26, 2026. Gatch discusses the opportunity for active ETFs, particularly in fixed income, and the limits of putting illiquid assets into ETF structures. He also looks at growing institutional adoption and the expansion of ETFs in markets outside the US. (Source: Bloomberg)
